sentences.text: Today we will talk about Honduras.
Honduras is a beautiful, green, and friendly country in Central America.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Honduras?
Honduras is in Central America.
It is between Guatemala, El Salvador, and Nicaragua.
It has coasts on both the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea.
It has mountains, forests, and beaches.
What is the capital city of Honduras?
The capital city is Tegucigalpa.
It is in the mountains and has churches, plazas, and busy streets.
Other important cities include San Pedro Sula, a large business center.
La Ceiba, on the Caribbean coast.
Copán, ruinous near ancient Maya sites.
Roatan, an island popular for diving and tourism.
How many people live in Honduras?
About 10.5 million people live in Honduras.
Most people live in cities or towns.
Honduras are known for being welcoming, hard -working, and kind.
What language do people speak in Honduras?
People speak Spanish.
It is the official language.
Some people also speak English, especially on the Bay Islands.
Indigenous languages like Garifuna, Mosquito, and Lenca are spoken in some regions.
What is the weather like in Honduras?
Honduras has a tropical climate.
There are two main seasons.
The rainy season, from May to October.
The dry season, from November to April.
It is usually warm or hot all year, especially near the coast.
What does Honduras look like?
Honduras has mountains and hills, rainforests and rivers.
Coral reefs in the Caribbean, beaches, lakes, and farmland.
It is home to many natural parks and Maya ruins like Copán.
What animals live in Honduras?
In the wild, you may see monkeys, jaguars, and deer, parrots, toucans, and hummingbirds, iguanas, frogs, and snakes.
Fish, turtles, and dolphins near the reefs.
There is rich wildlife, especially in the Mosquitia rainforest.
What do people eat in Honduras?
Honduran food is simple, fresh, and tasty.
People eat beans, rice, and corn tortillas.
Eggs, cheese, plantains, and avocados.
Chicken, fish, and beef.
Popular dishes, baleadas, tortillas with beans, cheese, and cream.
Tamales, corn dough with meat, wrapped in leaves.
Sopa de caracol, conch soup with coconut milk.
Fried plantains and cassava.
Pupusas, also common near El Salvador.
What do people drink in Honduras?
People drink coffee.
Coffee.
Honduras grows excellent coffee.
Horchata, a sweet drink made with rice or seeds.
Fresh fruit juice like mango, pineapple, or tamarind.
Water and soda.
Adults may drink beer or aguardiente, a strong local drink.
What is life like in Honduras?
Life in Honduras is often family -centered and community -based.
People enjoy spending time with family, going to church, listening to music and dancing, playing football soccer, visiting markets, and sharing meals.
In small towns, people live close to nature and help one another.
What are some holidays and traditions in Honduras?
Independence Day, September 15.
Samana Santa, Holy Week with processions and family trips.
Christmas and New Year with music, food, and fireworks.
Feria Juniana, a big fair in June in San Pedro Sula.
Garafuna Settlement Day, celebrated by Garafuna communities.
Festivals include parades, dances, food, and local music.
Some fun facts about Honduras.
The flag is blue and white with five stars.
The Maya City of Copan is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
The Bay Islands are famous for scuba diving and coral reefs.
The National Bird is the Scarlet Macaw.
Honduras means depths in Spanish for the deep sea near its coast.
Now you know many things about Honduras.
You know where it is, what people speak, and what they eat.
You learned about the culture, food, nature, and holidays.
Great job!
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emili.
